name: L10 SEVN dual-reference-disjoint fresh PAN source panel
question: Can a portal-conditioned OCR observation representation improve exact address reading on a third SEVN panel with no address or panorama-frame overlap with either earlier panel?

exclusion_feasibility.note: Metadata-only exhaustive checks found no remaining APPROACH episode at any cohort size from one through eight after both earlier panels were excluded. PAN remains dense, so the successor isolates observation representation on PAN without weakening disjointness or changing the action geometry.

selection_rule.pixel_blind: Open only coord.hdf5, label.hdf5, graph.pkl, and the two consumed public-source manifests. Do not open images.hdf5, high-res-panos.zip, a viewport, a crop, or any model output.
selection_rule.reference_exclusion: Exclude the union of every canonical street-name plus house-number pair and every panorama frame_id present in either earlier public source.
selection_rule.within_panel_exclusion: Use each target address and panorama frame once across the full 40-episode panel.
selection_rule.scenario_scope: Freeze only PAN_LEFT and PAN_RIGHT because no strictly fresh APPROACH episode remains after dual-reference exclusion.
selection_rule.ordering: Use the original deterministic candidate-goal order. Fill PAN_LEFT first with the first twenty eligible distinct addresses and frames, then PAN_RIGHT with the first twenty remaining eligible distinct addresses and frames.
selection_rule.pan_recovery: Keep the original plus or minus 90 degree start and 67.5 degree prescribed pan construction; require before != CORRECT_UNIQUE and after == CORRECT_UNIQUE from human metadata geometry.
selection_rule.prohibited_filters: Do not filter or rank by OCR visibility, image appearance, portal-model output, V2 output, successor output, or eventual pixel outcome.

stop_rule: Materialize the deterministic metadata-only panel once, refuse to overwrite outputs, and never replace episodes after pixel outcomes are observed.
claim_boundary: This freezes a third address- and panorama-disjoint PAN-only panel inside SEVN. It is not source-disjoint, action-general, city-disjoint, live-camera, product, user-benefit, or safety evidence.
